definitions.explanation: A medical test in which a sample of blood is taken and analyzed to check for illness, infection, nutritional deficiencies, or general health indicators.

examples.japanese: {血液検査|けつえきけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
あした⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{血液検査|けつえきけんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a blood test at the hospital tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {血液検査|けつえきけんさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The blood test results showed no particular problems.

examples.japanese: {血液検査|けつえきけんさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not eat before the blood test.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{血液|けつえき}→血液：02703_ketsueki⟧ (blood) + ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (examination, test). A standard medical procedure used to diagnose conditions, monitor chronic illnesses, and check general health as part of routine checkups (⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {血液検査|けつえきけんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to have a blood test
- {血液検査|けつえきけんさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: blood test results
- {血液検査|けつえきけんさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧: to find an abnormality in a blood test
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧{血液検査|けつえきけんさ}: regular blood test
- {血液検査|けつえきけんさ}⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧: blood test result sheet

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧: health checkup — typically includes a blood test
- ⟦{尿検査|にょうけんさ}→尿検査：23300_nyoukensa⟧: urine test — often done together with a blood test
- ⟦{採血|さいけつ}→採血：11074_saiketsu⟧: blood drawing — the act of taking the blood sample
- ⟦{血液型|けつえきがた}→血液型：03053_ketsuekigata⟧: blood type

USAGE:
Patients are often asked to fast (⟦{絶食|ぜっしょく}→絶食：19704_zesshoku⟧) before a blood test so that food intake does not affect the results.
